authority.coordinateConvention: Rectangles are [x,y,width,height] in normalized viewport pixels; visual anchors are approximate optical observations from the raster, not original vector metadata.

sharedGenerationContract.referenceUsage: Attach the full approved original as guidance. Generate each asset independently; do not crop, slice, copy, trace bitmap pixels, or promote screenshot fragments as runtime art.
sharedGenerationContract.preserve: Scene identity, object/character count, costume, pose, camera direction, object overlap, composition, and material family.
outputExclusions: No German labels or other text
No phone shell or camera island
No UI controls, panel borders, rounded card frame, progress dots, or CTA
No new decorative objects absent from the reference
sharedGenerationContract.style: Warm tactile 3D illustration with restrained sculpted surfaces, soft upper-left illumination, jade/teal, cream, olive foliage, warm wood and antique gold. Match the approved original rather than applying a generic flat-minhwa, toy, photographic, or anime restyle.
sharedGenerationContract.composition: Interest images are opaque complete rectangular scenes; runtime supplies card corners and label bands. Tiger and branch are complete standalone RGBA layers with clean transparency.
sharedGenerationContract.acceptance: Check whole generated master first, then render at the exact target rectangle. Accept visual scene/layout/material fidelity; do not require byte identity or invent similarity percentages.
sharedGenerationContract.residualDisclosure: Independent generation can leave small fur, leaf, grain and highlight differences. Disclose them explicitly after visual review. This does not waive changed faces, poses, object counts, costume, camera angle, or materially different framing.
sharedGenerationContract.preserveMasters: Save new candidates separately. Preserve existing masters and provenance. Do not silently replace approved/runtime assets.
